comparison: original C versus candidate native text extension
measured_api: base-install fuzz._levenshtein / fuzz._jaro_winkler; native calls secondary
estimator: median of all paired batch means; calibration excluded
noise_note: relative_spread is (slowest-fastest)/fastest; shared-host timings are not a universal performance guarantee
prior_results_note: bench/native-results.md compares Python versus C, not C versus Rust
toolchain_note: Compiler versions describe the current tools; use recorded build commands to establish the flags used for each saved binary.
memory_note: Fresh subprocess peak RSS includes Python, code, inputs, and allocator retention; peak increase may be zero when startup already set the high-water mark. This is not live native heap usage.

build_configuration.baseline: Unmodified src/unstd/text/_text_native.c, rebuilt via setuptools for CPython 3.13.14
build_configuration.candidate: UNSTD_TEXT_RUST=1 CIBUILDWHEEL=1 uv build --offline --wheel; extension extracted from wheel
build_configuration.rust: Cargo release profile in recorded native/text/Cargo.toml; offline locked build; rustc 1.96.0
build_configuration.host_note: Scoped SDK selection avoids a local installed-linker/new-SDK mismatch. No source workaround or machine-wide configuration change.

adoption.decision: Rejected for default adoption: short-Jaro latency and extension size regressions; RSS does not establish memory parity.
adoption.scope: These observations apply to this prototype on this host, not all possible Rust implementations.
